items.snippet: 불법체류자 A씨는 2020년 5월부터 2023년 11월까지 다른 사람의 건강보험 명의를 도용해 상급종합병원에서 간암 치료를 받았다. 3년 6개월간 진료받은 횟수만 105차례였다. 건강보험공단이 A씨 치료비에 지급한 돈은 7878만원이었다. 하지만 A씨가 사망하면서 국민건강보험공단은 이 돈을 한 푼도 돌려받지 못했다. 다른 사람의 명의로 10년 넘게 병원 진료를 받은 사례도 있었다. 한 도용자는 2012년 9월부터 2022년 10월까지 1974년생 여성 이모씨의 건강보험 명의를 이용해 동네 의원에서 불면증 진료를 받았다. 진료 횟수는 65차례, 부정수급액은 64만원이었다. 이 돈은 전액 환수됐다.

items.title: ‘오세훈 여론조사비 대납’… 2심서 무죄로 뒤집혔다
items.snippet: 오세훈 서울시장이 정치 브로커 명태균 씨로부터 여론조사 결과를 받고 그 비용을 후원자에게 대납하도록 한 혐의의 항소심에서 무죄를 선고받았다. 시장직 상실형인 벌금 1000만 원을 선고했던 1심이 뒤집힌 것이다. 내년 1월 전후로 예상되는 대법원 선고에서 무죄가 확정되면 오 시장은 직을 유지하게 된다. 23일 서울고법 형사7부(부장판사 구회근)는 명 씨에게 여론조사를 의뢰하고 그 비용을 후원자에게 대신 내게 한 혐의(정치자금법 위반)로 기소된 오 시장에게 무죄를 선고했다. 재판부는 “거의 유일한 직접 증거인 명 씨의 진술에 신빙성을 부여하기 어렵고, 단편적인 사실들만으로는 공소사실을 인정하기 부족하다”고 밝혔다. 앞서 1심은 오 시장에게 시장직 상실과 5년간 피선거권 제한에 해당하는 벌금 1000만 원과 추징금 2100만 원을 선고했다. 김건희...

items.title: 李 “52시간 예외 노동특례… 기존 시행령 수정 검토를”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 23일 반도체업계가 요구하는 주 52시간 예외 노동특례에 대해 “기존 제도 시행령을 수정하거나, 절차를 쉽게 하는 방법이 있는지 서로 깊이 논의해 보라”고 지시했다. 전남광주 반도체클러스터 등 메가 특구를 지원하기 위한 ‘초광역특구법(메가특구법)’에 특례 조항을 반영하기보다는 고용노동부 시행령 개정 등으로 특별연장근로 인가를 간편하게 하는 방식 등을 제안한 것으로 풀이된다. 이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 취임 후 두 번째로 규제합리화위원회 회의를 주재한 자리에서 반도체 업계가 반도체 연구개발(R&D) 인력에 대한 노동시간 특례를 도입해야 한다는 의견을 내자 “노동부 장관의 시행령으로 할 수 있는 여지들이 있어 보인다”며 “대전제는 특례법을 만들어가지고 추가 노동에 대해서 보상을 안 하는 걸 구상하면 안 된다. 그건 정말 후퇴하는...

items.title: ‘명태균 입’ 안믿은 법원… “유일한 직접증거 明진술 신빙성 약해”
items.snippet: “거의 유일한 직접증거인 명태균 씨의 진술에 신빙성을 부여하기 어렵다.” 23일 오세훈 서울시장에게 무죄를 선고한 서울고법 형사7부(부장판사 구회근)는 핵심 근거로 정치 브로커인 명 씨 진술의 신빙성을 들었다. 명 씨의 진술은 직접 경험한 사실과 단순히 추측에 근거하거나 과장한 것을 명확히 구분하기 어렵다는 것이다. 재판부는 오 시장 측과 명 씨가 몇 차례 만났고, 여론조사 결과 일부가 오 시장 캠프에 공유됐으며, 오 시장의 후원자 김한정 씨가 명 씨 측에 여러 차례 돈을 보낸 사실은 인정했다. 하지만 “이런 단편적인 사실만으로는 공소사실을 인정하기 부족하다”고 판단했다.① 明 진술 “그대로 믿기 어려워”오 시장에게 벌금 1000만 원을 선고하며 시장직 상실형을 내렸던 1심과 항소심의 판단을 가른 첫 번째 쟁점은 명 씨 진술의 신빙성이었다....

items.title: ‘명태균 진술’ 기댄 기소 잇단 제동… 尹-김건희도 항소심서 무죄
items.snippet: 2024년 정국을 뒤흔든 정치 브로커 명태균 씨의 주장이 법정에서 잇따라 받아들여지지 않고 있다. 명 씨가 연루된 주요 사건은 오세훈 서울시장과 윤석열 전 대통령, 김건희 여사의 여론조사 관련 사건과 국민의힘 김영선 전 의원과의 공천 대가 금품 수수 사건 등 4건이다. 그러나 23일 오 시장의 항소심 선고를 포함한 최근 판결 결과는 전부 무죄였다. 재판부들은 명 씨 진술의 신빙성을 낮게 보거나, 명 씨가 자기 영향력을 키우려 주장을 부풀렸을 가능성에 주목했다. 명 씨는 2024년 9월 김 여사의 공천 개입 의혹이 불거진 뒤 이른바 ‘황금폰’을 통해 김 여사와 주고받은 카카오톡 메시지를 공개하는 등 폭로를 이어갔다. 같은 해 10월에는 “내가 검찰 조사를 받으면 윤 대통령은 한 달이면 하야하고 탄핵될 것”이라고 말한 것으로 전해졌다. 명 씨는...

items.title: 오세훈 무죄에 與 “무죄 자판기 재판부” 野 “억지 기소 사필귀정”
items.snippet: ‘명태균 게이트’에 연루돼 1심에서 시장직 상실형을 선고받았던 오세훈 서울시장이 23일 항소심에서 무죄 판결을 받으면서 기사회생의 기회를 잡았다. 국민의힘은 이날 판결을 두고 정부·여당의 ‘법치 훼손’ 시도에 제동이 걸린 것이라며 “사필귀정”이라고 밝혔다. 대법원에서 무죄가 확정되면 국민의힘 장동혁 지도부에 대한 당내 견제 세력으로 재부상할 수 있다는 관측이 나온다. 더불어민주당은 “사법개혁의 도화선이 될 것”이라며 사법부에 대한 파상 공세에 나섰다. 다만 서울시장 보궐선거가 현실화되면 야당에 유리할 수 있다는 전망이 제기됐던 만큼 일각에선 “오히려 잘됐다”는 반응도 나왔다.● 吳, 무죄 확정 시 ‘張 견제 세력’으로 재부상오 시장은 이날 선고 직후 서울고법에서 기자들과 만나 “결백을 믿어주신 서울 시민 여러분께 진심으로 감사드린다. 더욱 열...

items.title: 李 “반도체 주52시간 예외, 새 제도 만들 필요 있나”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 23일 전남광주 반도체 클러스터를 지원하는 ‘초광역특구법(메가특구법)’에 주 52시간 예외 조항을 넣는 문제와 관련해 “기존 제도 시행령을 수정하거나, 절차를 쉽게 하는 방법이 있는지 서로 깊이 논의해 보라”고 했다. 이 대통령은 이날 오후 청와대에서 주재한 규제합리화위원회 2차 회의에서 반도체산업협회 측으로부터 핵심 연구개발(R&D) 인력의 근로시간 특례를 연내 실현해 달라는 건의를 받고 “절차가 불편하다면 포괄적으로 (인가를) 미리 해주면 된다. 그것 때문에 새로운 제도를 만들 필요가 있냐”며 이같이 말했다. 이어 “반도체 특별법’을 통과시킬 때 초과노동 예외를 넓혀놨다”며 “반도체산업협회는 현재 고용노동부가 한 조치 이상의 대책이 필요하다는 것인가”라고 반문했다. 이를 두고 초광역특구법에 주 52시간 예외 특례 조항을 넣...

items.snippet: 이재명 대통령의 국정 지지율이 30%대로 떨어진 지 7주 만에 40%대를 회복했다. 한국갤럽이 20∼22일 전국 만 18세 이상 1001명을 대상으로 실시해 23일 발표한 여론조사(전화면접 방식, 95% 신뢰수준에 표본오차 ±3.1%포인트, 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조)에 따르면 이 대통령에 대한 직무수행 평가는 “잘하고 있다”는 응답이 40%, “잘못하고 있다”는 답변이 50%로 집계됐다. 10%는 의견을 밝히지 않았다. 긍정 평가는 9월 셋째 주 37%로 취임 후 최저치를 기록한 뒤 직전 조사인 10월 셋째 주는 39%였다. 부정 평가는 9월 셋째 주에 기록한 56%가 최고치였다. 정당 지지율은 더불어민주당 37%, 국민의힘 28%로 집계됐다. 지지하는 정당이 없는 무당층은 27%를 기록했다. 직전 조사에서 민주당...

items.snippet: 더불어민주당 최고위원회의에서 23일 친명(친이재명)계와 친청(친정청래)계가 신천지 교인의 당원 가입 의혹 조사 결과 발표를 두고 공개 충돌했다. 8·17 전당대회 과정에서 불거진 계파 간 갈등이 재점화되며 당내 파열음이 커지고 있는 것. 친청계 이성윤 최고위원은 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위에서 “우리 당을 분열시키고 당원들에게 상처를 준 신천지 개입 의혹 조사 결과를 있는 그대로 국민과 당원께 공개해야 한다”며 “반명·분열주의·신천지 비밀 연합의 근거도 공개하고 이 문제를 매듭지어야 할 때”라고 말했다. 이 최고위원은 검경 합동수사본부의 수사에서 민주당 내 조직적 신천지 가입 정황이 드러나지 않았다는 점을 언급하며 “의혹이 사실이라면 관련자에게 책임을 묻고 근거가 없다면 그에 상응하는 엄중한 책임을 반드시 물어야 한다”고 강조했다. 앞선 전당대...

items.title: 최길수 특별감찰관 임명… 10년만에 재가동

items.title: 1심 “吳가 여론조사 의뢰” 2심 “明, 정치적 욕심에 한 것”
items.snippet: 23일 오세훈 서울시장 정치자금법 위반 사건 2심 재판부가 1심 유죄 판단을 무죄로 뒤집은 데는 정치 브로커 명태균씨 진술의 신빙성에 의문을 가진 게 중요하게 작용했다. 1심 재판부는 다른 정황과 맞아떨어지는 명씨 진술 일부를 믿어줬지만, 2심 재판부는 “전체적으로 믿기 어렵고, 일부 진술만 신뢰할 근거도 없다”고 판단했다. 2심 재판부는 오 시장이 명씨에게 여론조사를 맡기고 그 비용 3300만원을 후원자에게 대신 내게 한 동기와 관련해서도 1심과 다르게 판단했다.

items.title: 1946년 시작된 ‘가을의 전설’… 이번엔 선수·일반인 함께 달린다
items.snippet: 2만2259명이 춘천의 가을을 달린다. 80주년을 맞은 ‘가을의 전설’ 춘천마라톤(조선일보사·춘천시·스포츠조선·대한육상연맹 공동 주최)이 25일 강원도 춘천시 의암호 일대에서 열린다. 풀코스 1만1932명, 10㎞ 1만327명이 도전장을 냈다. 연령별로는 30대가 8753명(약 39%)으로 가장 많고, 40대가 6605명(약 30%)으로 그 다음이다.

items.title: “잠수교 차량 금지되기 전에 달리자” 오토바이 100대 한밤 폭주
items.snippet: 서울 잠수교 차량 통행이 26일부터 전면 금지된다. 잠수교는 교각을 같이 쓰는 위층 반포대교와 마찬가지로 차량이 다니지만 보행 전용 다리로 탈바꿈하기 위해 공사가 시작되면서다. 잠수교는 용산구 서빙고동과 서초구 반포동을 잇는 길이 795m 왕복 2차선 다리다. 한강 수면과 맞닿을 듯 낮게 놓여 강물과 야경을 가까이서 즐길 수 있어 서울 주요 드라이브 코스로 꼽혀왔다.

items.title: 단풍 들기도 전에 낙엽이 우수수… 숲의 비명이었다
items.snippet: 23일 오전 서울 중구 남산공원. 단풍이 물들기 시작해야 할 시기에 벌써 잎이 떨어져 앙상한 나뭇가지를 드러낸 나무가 일부 보였다. 초록 잎과 노랑·주황 잎이 섞여 달려 있는 왕벚나무 아래엔 낙엽이 수북했다. 경기 포천 국립수목원에선 올해 늦여름인 8월 말부터 4개 수종(樹種)에서 이 같은 현상이 관찰됐다. 콩배나무, 마가목, 왕벚나무 등 장미과 나무를 비롯해 높이가 20m까지 자라는 느릅나무과의 비술나무에서 잎이 떨어지기 시작했다.

items.title: ‘이화영 재판 집단퇴정’ 관여 검사들 징계위 끝났는데 통보는 왜 안 하나
items.snippet: 법무부는 이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사 위증 사건 재판에서 벌어진 ‘검사 집단 퇴정’에 관련된 부장검사 2명에 대해 지난 21일 검사징계위원회를 열었다. 그런데 23일까지도 당사자에게 징계위 의결 결과가 통보되지 않은 것으로 알려졌다. 앞서 대검찰청(현 공소청)은 두 부장검사를 징계하기 어렵다고 판단했다. 그러자 법무부는 직접 감찰에 나서 ‘견책’ 징계를 청구했다. 이 때문에 법조계에선 징계 결과 통보가 늦어지는 배경을 두고 여러 해석이 나오고 있다.

items.title: ‘공장에 인화물질’ 보고 받고도… 소방 지휘부 “공격적 진압하라”
items.snippet: ‘부천 금속 공장 화재’ 당시 소방 지휘부가 인화물질이 있다는 보고를 받고도 건물 안으로 들어가 불을 끄라고 지시한 것으로 확인됐다. 당시 불이 난 3층 근로자들은 전부 대피한 상태였다. 인화물질이 있는 건물에 소방관을 투입한 판단이 적절했는지 논란이 일고 있다.

items.title: 김치 사먹는 게 아이스크림보다 당분 섭취 많아
items.snippet: 한국인이 간식으로 섭취하는 당류(糖類)가 최근 4년 새 하루 평균 17.7g(2019년)에서 15.6g(2023년)으로 줄었다는 조사 결과가 23일 나왔다. 반면 한국인이 식사로 섭취하는 당류는 하루 평균 19g에서 19.9g으로 늘었다. 서울대 건강문화사업단(단장 윤영호 서울대 의대 교수)은 이같이 식품의약품안전처의 국민 건강 영양 조사 자료를 분석한 연구 결과를 소개했다.

items.snippet: 지난 17일 오후 1시 30분쯤 찾은 경기 용인의 무한리필 고깃집 ‘스타미트스타캠핑 정육식당’. 손님 7명이 점심 식사를 하고 있었다. 목살·삼겹살·LA갈비 등이 들어 있는 냉동고와 김치·마늘·양파 등 밑반찬을 꺼내 먹을 수 있는 냉장고가 비치돼 있었지만 일하는 직원은 보이지 않았다. 이 식당은 오후 9시부터 다음날 오후 4시까지는 무인(無人)으로 운영된다. 매장 안팎에는 ‘심야 무인 고깃집’ ‘계산 셀프’ 같은 종이가 붙어 있었다. 무인 운영 시간대에 손님들은 고기를 굽는 것은 물론이고 된장찌개를 끓이고 반찬을 리필하는 일도 ‘셀프’로 해야 한다. 이 업체 사장 A(52)씨는 “2년 전에 고깃집을 열었는데 직원을 하루 4시간씩 주 5일만 써도 인건비가 200만~250만원 정도라 부담이 컸다”며 “올해 3월부터 저녁 식사 시간에만 내가 상주하...

items.title: 한국보다 외국서 더 인기인 ‘bojagi’
items.snippet: 지난 20일 오후 5시 서울 마포구 ‘스튜디오 보자기’. 보자기 포장 방법과 매듭 묶는 법을 배우는 ‘보자기 클래스’가 한창이었다. 미국인 제나 알콘(28)씨는 최근 보자기의 존재를 알게 된 뒤 그 매력에 빠져 어머니와 함께 수업을 들으러 왔다. 그의 어머니 엘리자베스 앳킨슨(69)씨는 “와인병 감싸는 법을 배우고 싶다”며 “크리스마스 선물 포장할 때 활용할 생각”이라고 했다.

items.title: 소지품만 던져 놓고 “내 자리”… 원격 영역 표시 ‘K-자리 맡기’
items.snippet: 벤치 위에 짐짝이 한가득이었다. 먹다 만 간식에 쇼핑백, 배낭까지. 20일 오후 서울 롯데월드 복판, 물건 주인은 30분 넘게 나타나지 않았다. 사정은 뻔했다. 곧 열릴 야간 퍼레이드 공연 명당자리를 소지품으로 선점한 것이다. 한 직원이 ‘자리 맡기 금지’라고 적힌 카트를 끌고 와 물건을 담고는 분실물 보관소로 옮겼다. 그는 “아마 지금쯤 놀이기구를 타고 있을 것”이라며 “접이식 의자나 유모차 등으로 자리만 맡아 놓고 공연 직전에 와서는 점유권을 주장하는 경우가 많아 이용객 간 형평성을 위해 수거 조치를 시행하고 있다”고 말했다.

items.title: 부의함·육개장 없애고 청바지 입고 치른 장례… 비로소 고인이 보였다
items.snippet: 송길원 목사 (아무튼주말 게재 전 사용금지)- 영상미디어 이신영 기자" height="5197" src="https://www.chosun.com/resizer/v2/7OYQHHVJNNGTTAJC6JPOBEPSW4.jpg?auth=8bdb7f9c6a6b53ed4987df69373ec26ffd491fc01ce94b23a5b4c52c83962b77&smart=true&width=3465&height=5197" width="3465" /> 지난 9월 치러진 송길원(69) 목사 부친 장례식에는 다섯 가지가 없었다. 근조 화환, 부의함, 부고장, 꽃 제단, 육개장. 경기도 양평 하이패밀리센터에 차려진 빈소에서 송 목사는 검은 양복과 상주 완장 대신 흰 셔츠에 청바지를 입었다. 영정 사진을 둘러싼 화려한 꽃 제단도 만들지 않았다. 대신 낡은 구두와 탁상...

items.title: 우크라 또 北 포로 보낸다면, 李정부는 거부할 건가
items.snippet: 이번 학기 내 학생 중에 우크라이나 학생이 한 명 있다. 지지난주 수업 때, 이 학생에게 최근 한국·우크라이나 관계에 대해 물었다. 그는 마치 기다렸다는 듯 자기 의견을 쏟아냈다.

items.title: 타코, 흑당, 감주… 다가온 호빵의 계절 입맛대로 고르세요
items.snippet: 삼립의 겨울 대표 간식 ‘삼립호빵’이 다가오는 겨울 시즌을 맞아 배우 공명을 새로운 모델로 발탁하고, ‘타코 호빵’, ‘흑당단팥·감주통팥 호빵’ 신제품을 선보이며 본격적인 겨울 마케팅에 나선다. 누적 판매량 69억개를 돌파하며 대한민국 겨울 간식의 대명사로 자리 잡은 삼립호빵은 올해 익숙한 스테디셀러의 내실을 다지는 한편, 트렌디한 감각의 신제품과 다채로운 캠페인을 앞세워 올겨울 소비자 입맛 잡기에 나섰다.

items.title: “얼굴도 없는데 설렌다”… 가로등 신사, 촛불 아가씨가 인기라는데
items.snippet: 눈도 코도 입도 없다. 머리는 가로등이고, 몸에는 연미복을 걸쳤다. 그런데 이 수상한 남자가 등장하면 관객들은 “잘생겼다”며 환호하고, 휴대전화를 들어 ‘직캠’을 찍는다. 그와 눈을 맞추거나 손하트를 받으려고 공연장을 여러 차례 찾는 팬도 있다. 핼러윈 시즌을 맞은 서울 잠실 롯데월드에서 인기 스타로 떠오른 ‘가로등 신사’ 베스퍼 이야기다. 얼굴도 없는 이 별난 신사가 사람들의 마음을 사로잡은 것이다.

items.title: 가을날
items.snippet: 고등학교 시절 국어 선생님은 등단한 시인이었습니다. 선생님은 수업 시간 중 가끔 교과서에 실리지 않는 시를 소개해주셨습니다. 그때 소개받은 시 가운데 가장 기억에 남는 시가 함형수 시인의 ‘해바라기의 비명’입니다. 저의 애송시 가운데 하나가 되었습니다. 원로 문학평론가 유종호 교수님의, 시 한 편으로 1급 시인으로 평가받을 수도 있는데 함형수 시인의 경우가 그렇다는 말씀을 듣고 내 일인 양 기뻤습니다. 참 사소한 것이지만, 그것도 세상 사는 재미입니다.

items.title: 대통령 측근의 무능과 부패에… 청년 수만명이 죽어나갔다
items.snippet: 6·25전쟁 개전 초기 인민군은 남한 점령지역에서 20여만명의 청년을 의용군으로 강제 징집했다. 1950년 10월 국군과 유엔군이 압록강까지 밀고 올라갔던 전세가 중공군의 참전으로 역전되면서, 대한민국 정부는 미래의 병력 자원인 청년들을 후방의 안전지대로 후송할 대책을 강구했다.

items.title: 불안한 시대의 안식처
items.snippet: 식품업계에 ‘복고 바람’이 불고 있습니다. 롯데칠성음료는 2015년 단종했던 양주 ‘캪틴큐’를 이달 재출시했습니다. 과거 병과 뚜껑, 라벨 디자인을 그대로 살려 옛날 감성을 강조했습니다. 하지만 주정에 럼 향을 섞어 양주 느낌만 냈다는 평가를 받았던 과거와 달리 이번에는 진짜 럼 원액을 사용했다고 하네요. 농심은 2017년 출시해 2024년 단종된 ‘볶음너구리’를 오는 27일 재출시합니다. 아성다이소는 식품업계와 손잡고 오리온 ‘초코파이’, 롯데웰푸드 ‘빼빼로’, 크라운제과 ‘죠리퐁’, 해태제과 ‘맛동산’ 등 9종의 인기 장수 과자를 출시 초기와 같은 포장으로 올 초 내놓았습니다.

items.title: 민둥산엔 은빛 억새, 함백산엔 단풍 산사… 가을 여행의 정석, 정선
items.snippet: 파란 가을 하늘 아래 은빛 억새가 산바람 따라 이리저리 군무를 추는 풍경은 오직 일 년 중 이 시기에만 볼 수 있는 진풍경 중 하나. 억새가 손짓하는 계절에 ‘민둥산은빛억새꽃축제’(~11월 8일)가 한창인 민둥산에 올랐다. 가을빛으로 물드는 태백산맥의 능선을 거닐고, 광부들의 삶이 눅진하게 녹아든 폐 탄광 박물관에서 사라져가는 산업화 시대의 초상과 마주했다. 여기에 단풍 내린 천 년 고찰과 사람 냄새 물씬 풍기는 시골 장터 구경까지, 정선이라는 소도시가 일궈온 시간을 걸었다.

items.title: 비싸서 마음껏 못 먹던 장어… 언제 이렇게 싸진 거지?
items.snippet: 보양식의 대명사 장어. 큰마음 먹고 지갑을 열어야 맛볼 수 있었던 외식 메뉴였지만, 최근 ‘장어 무한 리필’ ‘1인분 9800원 민물장어’를 큼지막하게 내건 식당이 우후죽순 들어서고 있다. 1㎏에 5만~7만원을 훌쩍 넘던 장어를 무제한 제공하거나, 1만원도 되지 않는 가격에 사계절 판매하는 파격적 프랜차이즈 모델이 등장했다.

items.title: 썰매의 이름은 ‘백두대간’
‘세계 최대 호수무대’서 올리는 ‘라 트라비아타’… 007 영화에 나온 ‘그곳’
items.snippet: 보덴호의 서쪽 하늘이 붉게 물드는 밤 9시, 오스트리아 서쪽 끝 브레겐츠의 여름 페스티벌은 본격적으로 시작된다. 호수를 향해 부채꼴로 펼쳐진 객석(6722석)에 들어서면 높이 28미터, 넓이 약 700㎡의 거대한 거울이 무대를 통째로 차지하고 있다. 86개 조각으로 이뤄진 대형 거울은 비올레타의 아름다움과 추락을 비추는 주요 장치다. 바람과 물결을 따라 베르디의 선율이 흘렀다.

items.title: 왜 아름다운 것을 멀리서만 찾았을까
items.snippet: 윌리엄 해즐릿의 에세이 제목(‘왜 먼 것이 좋아 보이는가’)대로 아름다운 것은 늘 멀리 있는 것 같다. 10월 초에 영화 몇 편을 보겠다고 부산국제영화제에 갔다. 대부분의 영화는 기다리면 차차 개봉해 동네에서 편하게 볼 수 있다는 걸 알고 있지만 꼭 그곳에서 시간표에 쫓겨가며 간신히 극장에 앉아 피곤한 몸으로 영화를 보며 축제의 일부가 되고 싶었다. 기분은 합리적인 것이 아니니까. 3박 4일 동안 나는 14편의 영화를 22시간 18분 동안 봤다.

items.title: 그건 사랑이 아니야 [고혜련의 삶이 있는 풍경] (27)
items.snippet: “다른 데 가서 하면 안 돼요? 보기 민망하네.” 여의도 한강가 풀밭에 앉아 쉬고 있던 어느 여름 저녁. 어둑해지자 불빛이 환해진 가로등에 기대 ‘점입가경’의 애정표현에 돌입한 젊은 남녀를 코앞에서 보고 도저히 넘어갈 수 없어 냅다 소리를 질렀다. 그들은 곧 당황한 듯 사라졌으나 얼마 후 다시 나타났다. 이번에는 의기양양한 얼굴에 반말로 “남의 일에 웬 참견이냐”며 내 가족의 어깨를 쳤다. 무언가 무장하고 왔다는 직감이 왔다. 순간 위험을 느껴 급히 움직이며 전화기로 112에 신고한 듯 외쳤다. “여기 큰일 났어요. 급히 출동해 주세요.” 그들은 움찔하며 사라졌고 위기를 모면했다는 생각이 들었다. 옆에서 “거봐, 그런 건 모른 척하는 게 상책”이라 했지만 그들에게 하고 싶은 말은 여전하다.

items.title: 노을이 건너는 다리
items.snippet: 어린 시절 들었던 가수 혜은이 노래에 나오는 ‘제3한강교’가 지금의 한남대교라는 건 한참 나중에 알게 됐다. 동시에 궁금해 찾아본 제1한강교는 지금의 한강대교, 제2한강교는 지금의 양화대교다. 걸어서 건널 수 있는 한강 다리 가운데 주변 전망이 좋고 걷기 편한 다리로 추천하는 게 한강대교다. 한강대교의 또 다른 매력 요소는 다리 가운데 있는 노들섬이다. 요즘은 10여개의 시내버스 노선이 지나고 있어 접근성이 크게 높아졌다.

items.title: 흔들리지 않는 정신력 갖추려면… “매일 1인치씩 밀어붙여라” [안광복의 주말의 철학]
items.snippet: “주식 시장은 매일 찾아오는 조울증이 있는 동업자와 같다.” 워런 버핏의 스승인 벤저민 그레이엄의 말이다. 달떠 있을 때는 아주 비싼 가격에 증권을 사지만, 기분이 가라앉을 때는 내일 세상이 망할 듯이 호들갑을 떨며 터무니없이 싼 값에 자기 지분을 내놓는 식이다. 더구나 이런 일은 매일 거듭된다. 꼭 지금의 우리 증시를 보는 듯하다. 이런 상황에서 안정적이고 꾸준하게 수익을 올리려면 어찌해야 할까?

items.snippet: Every year the art and design fair AKAA, or "Also Known as Africa", brings dozens of African and Afro-descendant artists to the French capital. As the 11th edition gets underway, we welcome Nigerian painter Midegbeyan Ojisua and South African artist Olivié Keck.

items.title: 서울서 남북 교전·北주석궁 폭격… 게임이라 괜찮나, 선을 넘었나
items.snippet: 한 편의점에서 군인 여럿이 나온다. 한 군인이 “바나나 우유를 안 샀다”며 아쉬워하는 순간 무전기가 먹통이 된다. 곧이어 거리 가로등과 건물 불빛이 일제히 꺼지고, 폭발음과 함께 곳곳에서 불길이 치솟는다. 북한 기습 남침으로 한반도에 전쟁이 벌어진다는 가상 시나리오를 담은 게임 ‘콜 오브 듀티: 모던워페어4(모던워페어4)’ 한 장면이다. 게이머는 해병대 ‘박현준 이병’ 시점에서 전쟁에 뛰어든다. 정식 출시 전 기능 일부를 제한한 베타 버전 게임을 하며 이 장면을 유튜브로 방송하던 게이머는 놀란 듯 “뭐야, 뭐야, 전쟁이야?”라고 했다. 채팅창에는 “디테일이 엄청나다” “진짜 같다”는 반응이 쏟아졌다.

items.title: NN-Based Transistor Modeling for Ultra-Fast SPICE Simulation and Standard Cell Library Characterization
items.abstract: Neural network (NN)-based transistor models have proven to be a promising solution to accelerate device modeling. Although these models demonstrated remarkable speedup in circuit simulations, they were not rigorously tested in complex tasks within standard EDA tool flows for chip design, which require very high transistor model precision to provide accurate results and converge properly. To investigate their full potential and promise, we develop NN-based transistor models that accurately predict the drain current and various charges for a 3nm nanosheet, and employ the models for a standard cell library characterization. This enables us to evaluate the accuracy and speedup under a very wide range of SPICE simulations, benchmarking our models against an industry-standard implementation. items.title: The Reaction of Financial Markets to the Releases of DeepSeek R1 and Kimi K3: A Critical Analysis
items.abstract: This paper compares financial-market reactions to the releases of DeepSeek R1 in January 2025 and Kimi K3 in July 2026. Both AI models were presented as credible Chinese competitors near the capability frontier, but their releases conveyed different economic information. DeepSeek R1 combined open weights with unusually low reported training and inference costs, prompting investors to reassess expected demand for computing infrastructure and producing large stock-price decreases among semiconductor and data-centre-related firms. Kimi K3 instead entered at broadly frontier prices and generated a market reaction concentrated more heavily among rival Chinese AI laboratories. items.title: Localization Contrast As a Fundamental Limit of Radiative Quantum Efficiency
items.abstract: Disorder can localize valence- and conduction-band states to different degrees, yet whether such localization contrast has observable consequences remains poorly understood. Here, we show that localization contrast strongly impacts competing carrier-recombination channels. We illustrate this behavior in random In$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N alloys. Increasing the In content from $x=13.5\%$ to $x=22\%$ progressively localizes the valence-band maximum state while leaving the conduction-band minimum state comparatively delocalized. This contrasting localization decreases the interband optical momentum matrix element underlying radiative recombination. For Auger-Meitner recombination, however, localization alone does not determine the coupling; atomic-scale disorder also breaks primitive-cell translational symmetry and modifies the momentum-space and phase structure of the states. items.title: Strain-induced structural transformations in hexagonal monolayer boron nitride. A density functional study
items.abstract: In this work we theoretically study the structural transformations occurring in monolayer hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) subjected to strong deformations. The first-principle computer simulations are based on the density functional theory employing the pseudopotentials with the exchange-correlation energy given in Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof form. Depending on the direction and the type of the strain, the simulations reveal different types of structural transformations in two-dimensional (2D) h-BN associated with the elastic failure. It is found that, under certain shear strains, there can form an ordered 2D orthorhombic phase with the 2D layer space symmetry pmmm. Thermal stability of the latter up to ~900 K is demonstrated by first-principle Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics. items.title: Electrically Pumped Quadratic-Soliton Mode-Locked Laser in Lithium Niobate Nanophotonics
items.abstract: Femtosecond mode-locked lasers are the workhorse of modern photonics, enabling optical atomic clocks, frequency combs, precision spectroscopy, and ultrafast signal processing. Bringing them onto nanophotonic chips promises miniaturized ultrafast systems, yet combining femtosecond pulse generation with electrical pumping remains a major challenge, rooted in a trade-off between the speed and energy efficiency of mode-locking mechanisms. Kerr-based mechanisms offer nearly instantaneous response but typically require high intracavity peak powers that are difficult to achieve with nanophotonic-compatible semiconductor gain. Conversely, semiconductor saturable absorbers enable strong nonlinear responses at low energies but are limited by their slow carrier dynamics. Here we break this trade-off by introducing quadratic-soliton mode-locking based on a quadratic nonlinear interferometer (QNLI):...

items.title: Electronic, structural and magnetic properties of goldene nanoribbons
items.abstract: Recently, two-dimensional goldene, a single-atomic-layer gold sheet, has been experimentally realized and is expected to be a promising material for next-generation devices, offering new possibilities beyond three-dimensional bulk gold. Because quasi-one-dimensional derivatives can exhibit properties markedly different from their two-dimensional counterparts, we investigate the stability, electronic, and magnetic properties of goldene-based nanoribbons (GOLDNRs) using first-principles computational methods. Our findings demonstrate that the electronic structure of these nanoribbons depends strongly on both edge chirality and ribbon width. Depending on the boundary configuration, the systems can exhibit semiconducting behavior with electronic band gaps of approximately 0.77 eV and 0.04 eV, or retain metallic characteristics. items.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits distinct computational characteristics across its two phases: prefill is compute-intensive, whereas decode is more memory-bound. As a result, AI accelerators achieve varying levels of efficiency across the two phases. GPUs are well suited to prefill, but are often underutilized during decode. By contrast, NPUs can utilize their compute resources more effectively during decode. Motivated by this observation, we explore a heterogeneous architecture that integrates GPUs and NPUs, mapping prefill to GPUs and decode to NPUs to achieve high performance and efficiency. However, realizing such heterogeneous integration is challenging because LLM phase disaggregation requires KV cache transfer from prefill to decode (that is, from GPUs to NPUs), which is complicated by differences in inter-device communication mechanisms and KV cache tensor layouts. items.abstract: We observe novel optical fringes and emission coherence in laterally formed semiconductor fins using wavelength- and angle-resolved cathodoluminescence (WARCL). These findings demonstrate that cavity mode and emission confinement are directly governed by cavity geometry including cavity dimensions, facet angles, and orientation. In flat fins narrowing the width from 3000 nm to 200 nm sharpens fringe intensity, indicating stronger mode confinement and increased coherence. Finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations confirm that the observed fringes originate from internal reflections among the fin facets, consistent with a Fabry-Pérot (FP) cavity model where the cavity length determines the fringe spacing. items.abstract: Large anisotropic magnetoresistance (AMR) usually relies on magnetic ordering, which fixes a preferred moment orientation and couples it to charge transport. Here, we demonstrate that pronounced AMR can instead arise from the anisotropic magnetic-field-induced polarization of dilute local moments in paramagnetic Fe-doped Ta4SiTe4, a quasi-one-dimensional van der Waals narrow-gap semiconductor. Magnetization measurements reveal Curie-like paramagnetism down to 2 K, with the c axis as the magnetic easy axis. The magnetization is described by an effective S = 1/2 model with an anisotropic g-factor ratio of g_c/g_ab = 1.43(1). items.title: Coherent dynamics and ultrafast evolution of optical nonlinearity of self-hybridized exciton-polaritons in WSe2
items.abstract: Exciton-polaritons (EPs) are valuable for investigating macroscopic quantum coherent phenomena. However, overcoming the rapid decoherence of EPs under ambient conditions is challenging, even using delicately fabricated optical cavities. Here, we show pronounced coherent dynamics in thin flakes of WSe2 supporting self-hybridized EPs. Ultrafast two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy (2DES) resolves two types of quantum beating: Rabi oscillation with a period of ~ 24 fs and a slower, ~ 50 fs period oscillation, revealing coherent coupling not only between excitons and cavity, but also between polaritons and dark states. Rapid evolution of 2DES line shape indicates a change of dominant optical nonlinearities from Rabi contraction of polaritons to many-body interactions of excitons in the first 100 fs, marking the transition from coherent to incoherent polariton excitations. items.title: The Spectroscopic Atlas of Excitonic Complexes in hBN-Encapsulated S-TMD Monolayers: From Excitons to Oxcitons and Beyond
items.abstract: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) encapsulation has transformed the optical spectroscopy of semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers (MLs) by suppressing extrinsic disorder and enabling the resolution of an increasingly complex hierarchy of excitonic states. This Review provides a spectroscopy-oriented framework for understanding and identifying excitonic complexes in hBN-encapsulated Mo- and W-based MLs and their alloys. The discussion covers bright and dark excitons, Rydberg states, charged excitons, biexcitons, phonon-assisted replicas, and higher-order Fermi-sea many-body states, including hexcitons and oxcitons, with an emphasis on the experimental signatures that distinguish them. items.title: Online Open-World Wafer Defect Discovery using Hyperdimensional Computing
items.abstract: Conventional wafer defect analysis relies on offline, closed-world classifiers that fail to detect novel, unseen defect signatures emerging during continuous semiconductor manufacturing. To address this, we propose WaferHDC, an online open-world wafer defect discovery framework based on hyperdimensional computing (HDC). The memory-centric architecture of WaferHDC enables rapid anomaly detection and grouping of recurring failures into compact hypervector representations. This allows the memory space to dynamically scale with new defect modes without retraining a static classifier or archiving entire raw wafer history. WaferHDC first models normal spatial distributions, then dynamically groups recurring failures into persistent defect memory without labels or predefined class counts. items.title: Ultrafast and Anisotropic Exciton Transport in Layered NbOI$_2$
items.abstract: Ferroelectric layered semiconductors provide a unique platform for exploring coupled excitonic and electronic phenomena in reduced dimensions. Here, exciton transport in layered NbOI$_2$ is investigated using transient absorption microscopy. Ultrafast and strongly anisotropic exciton diffusion is observed. The diffusion coefficient of about 160 cm$^2$ s$^{-1}$ along the nonpolar crystal axis is among the highest reported for van der Waals semiconductors. The transport exhibits an approximately twofold in-plane anisotropy between the polar and nonpolar directions, reflecting the intrinsic low-symmetry crystal structure of NbOI$_2$. The environmental stability of NbOI$_2$ is further investigated, and fabrication and encapsulation conditions required to achieve long-term sample stability are identified. items.title: Control of Isolated Four-Quadrant Single-Stage Three-/Single-Phase X-Rectifier for EV On-Board Chargers
items.abstract: The single-stage isolated eXtended-functionality rectifier (X-Rectifier) electric vehicle (EV) on-board charger (OBC) employs 650V GaN monolithic bidirectional power transistors (M-BDS) in the input stage, provides sinusoidal input currents and four-quadrant operation in three-phase and split/single phase grids without power derating, operates from asymmetrical three-phase mains, provides reactive power if needed, and supports extremely asymmetric phase loading in standalone vehicle-to-load (V2L) mode. items.title: Accelerating real-time hybrid-functional calculations with learned ACE and symmetry-based FFT reuse
items.abstract: Real-time hybrid-functional calculations require repeated reconstruction of nonlocal exchange, whose cost grows rapidly with Brillouin-zone sampling. We develop two methods to improve the efficiency of time evolution and spatial processing. The first learns the time evolution of adaptively compressed exchange (ACE) factors and predicts their updates, reducing the frequency of explicit reconstruction. The second uses crystal symmetry to reuse exchange fast Fourier transforms (FFTs) among equivalent real-space points. This symmetry-based FFT reuse (SBFR) reduces the number of FFTs while retaining the full $\bm k$-point sum. The methods can be used with a variety of hybrid functionals, and we use HSE06 in this work. Relative to an ACE reference using full-row mesh FFTs, learned prediction provides more than fivefold acceleration, SBFR more than fourteenfold, and their combination more than...

items.title: Nanophotonic Extreme Ultraviolet Polarimeter
items.abstract: Nanophotonic engineering has revolutionized how we manipulate the polarization of visible light. Here, we extend such control to extreme ultraviolet radiation, the spectral region of attosecond science and semiconductor lithography, where transmissive optical elements are lacking. We implement channel waveguides that restrict incident 41-nm-wavelength light to a few modes with defined spatial profiles and propagation constants. By designing the propagation-length-dependent interference of two eigenmodes, we achieve polarization-dependent forward scattering, which we exploit to create a transmissive nanophotonic analyzer that resolves the polarization axis and spectrum of extreme ultraviolet light from a single measurement. With a 0.9°-sensitivity for polarization rotations in a 1-second measurement and single-shot capability, the device opens new experimental opportunities in ultrafast m...

items.title: Charge-conserving creation and annihilation of topological phase singularities in atomically thin semiconductors
items.abstract: Atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides provide a promising material platform for optical phase manipulation, as rapid variations in their dielectric functions can give rise to topological phase singularities (PSs). However, PS evolution while preserving topological charge conservation has not yet been investigated in exciton enabled PS systems. Here, using atomically thin MoS2 films on sapphire as a model system, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate that the evolution of dielectric dispersion determines the creation, trajectory, merging, and annihilation of optical PSs under topological charge conservation. By varying the MoS2 film thickness, we experimentally realize this evolution through the gradual shrinking of the high energy n-k dispersion loop, which modifies its intersection with the zero reflection condition. items.title: Nanocrystalline cubic boron arsenide growth on GaAs(100) by gas source molecular beam epitaxy
items.abstract: Cubic boron arsenide (c-BAs) is a promising ultrahigh thermal conductivity semiconductor, but its direct synthesis on lattice-mismatched substrates remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate the synthesis of nanocrystalline c-BAs thin films on GaAs(100) substrates using gas source molecular beam epitaxy. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals an optimal growth temperature window of 250-400 C to maintain near stoichiometry and suppress severe arsenic loss. Surface and structural characterizations via atomic force microscopy, reflection high-energy electron diffraction, and grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction demonstrate a Volmer-Weber 3D island growth mode and a preferential crystallographic alignment with the GaAs substrate. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy confirms a chemically sharp interface without gallium interdiffusion into the c-BAs layer. These findings establish...

items.title: Multiplexed Label-Free Cytokine Sensing Using a 128x128 CMOS ISFET Array with Flexdym Microfluidic Partitioning
items.abstract: Cytokine-mediated inflammation disorders such as sepsis and cytokine release syndrome demand bedside multiplex panels that resolve pro- and anti-inflammatory dynamics in minutes, yet label-free FET cytokine sensors remain limited to few devices, single analytes, and PDMS packaging that sorbs small molecules and leaches oligomers. We present a CMOS platform pairing a 128 x 128 ion-sensitive field-effect transistor (ISFET) array (SkyWater 130 nm, SiN gate) with a FlexDym 4 x 1 micro-well overlay that partitions the membrane into four chemically independent regions (approximately 2,176 pixels each, square-root-of-N averaging). Two wells carry capture antibodies (anti-IL-6, anti-IL-10), one is a non-specific reference, and one tests specificity; the transduced signal is defined as the differential current relative to the reference signal (Delta I_D(W_n) - Delta I_D(W_3)). Its robust semantics, which assign real rather than binary truth values, are an essential ingredient of systems testing and runtime monitoring. In a number of system testing scenarios, the designer and the tester are separate parties. This testing-as-a-service model is common in software, avionics, and semiconductors, and is growing in importance in the red-teaming of machine learning models. items.title: Anchored Exploration in Product Evolution: A Phylogenetic Network Framework for Semiconductor Designs
items.abstract: We develop a product phylogenetic network framework for examining anchored exploration. Using 102,465 semiconductor products grouped into 45,996 design families, we distinguish accumulated design continuity (Anchor) from externally precedented feature additions (horizontal transfer, HT). Fitted regressions yield non-monotonic relationships for HT occurrence and descendant carriage, alongside increasing within-family carriage over observed support. These patterns connect technological trajectories and recombination by distinguishing the continuity associated with incorporating external features from that associated with reproducing them in subsequent products.

items.abstract: We demonstrate efficient electron doping of exfoliated MoS$_2$ through the deposition of N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC) molecules onto its surface. Raman spectroscopy reveals a pronounced softening of the optical A$_{1g}$ phonon mode after NHC deposition, consistent with electron transfer from the NHC molecules to the MoS$_2$ layers. items.title: Water-Driven Porous Silicon as a Platform for Blue Materials

items.abstract: We report the cryogenic characterization of a 14-nm nMOS Forksheet transistor down to 10 mK. We demonstrate that the device retains transistor operation with improved characteristics at cryogenic temperatures, while also forming a gate-defined quantum dot that can be tuned to the single-electron regime. In the quantum-dot regime, we perform low-frequency charge-noise measurements across different charge occupations and observe an average charge-noise amplitude of $\langle S_0\rangle = 10\;μ\mathrm{eV}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ at 1 Hz, with a minimum measured value of $3.3\;μ\mathrm{eV}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$. These results highlight the potential of Forksheet technology for the monolithic cointegration of quantum and classical CMOS functionalities in future quantum processors.

items.title: Revealing Detailed Transport Mechanisms in Silicon Tunneling Diodes
items.abstract: Understanding carrier transport in heavily doped semiconductor junctions is essential for developing next-generation tunneling devices for cryogenic electronics and steep-slope technologies. In this work, we investigate the transport mechanisms in a silicon tunneling diode using extensive TCAD (Technology Computer Aided Design) simulations benchmarked against electrical measurements over a wide temperature range of 4 K to 440 K. The measured device characteristics show no negative differential conductance, strong temperature dependence of forward current with a nearly constant semi-logarithmic slope, and weak temperature dependence under high reverse bias. To identify the mechanisms underlying these characteristics, we investigate the contributions of band-to-band tunneling (BTBT), trap-assisted tunneling (TAT), Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) recombination, and avalanche generation. items.title: Engineering nonrelativistic spin splitting in semiconductors by altermagnetic proximity
items.abstract: Altermagnets combine vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent, nonrelativistic spin splitting, offering functionalities attractive for spintronics and quantum devices. Their practical use, however, is constrained by the limited availability of materials that simultaneously possess the required altermagnetic symmetry, semiconducting electronic structure, and weak spin-orbit coupling. Here we show that these requirements can instead be separated between constituent materials through proximity engineering. We develop an analytical theory for a conventional semiconductor coupled to a gapped $d$-wave altermagnet and demonstrate that virtual tunneling transfers the altermagnetic spin splitting to the semiconductor. items.title: From quantum emitters to technological platforms: a perspective on semiconductor quantum dots
items.abstract: Photonic quantum technologies are based on controlled photon states. To generate these, quantum dots have emerged as excellent sources of single and entangled photons. In this Perspective, we briefly review the chronological development of quantum dots as photon sources, from their beginnings as quantum emitters in the early 2000s to the advanced photonic devices being developed today. We highlight the interplay between fundamental research and industrial aspects before discussing the photonic quantum technologies we expect to emerge in the near future.

Realistic surface models reveal substantial site-dependent variations in reaction energies and activation barriers, with silanol groups serving as the primary adsorption sites for aminosilane and related inhibitors and metal precursors. items.title: Coherent phonons in photoexcited semiconductors from first principles
items.abstract: Coherent phonons are phase-locked lattice vibrations that provide a sensitive probe of nonequilibrium dynamics in materials. Existing first-principles equation-of-motion (EOM) approaches have successfully described coherent phonons in metals and semimetals, but their extension to semiconductors requires treating the long-lived electron--hole plasma created by above-gap excitation. Here we extend the first-principles EOM framework to photoexcited semiconductors by incorporating the residual plasma force that shifts the lattice equilibrium together with the plasma-induced renormalization of the electronic structure. For monolayer MoTe$_2$, the calculated carrier-density-dependent Te displacement agrees with constrained density-functional perturbation theory only when the renormalized band structure is included. items.title: Programmable Preparation of Topological Entangled States
items.abstract: Programmable preparation of entangled quantum states is a central requirement for scalable quantum information processing, quantum networking and photonic quantum computing. Topological photonic platforms offer an attractive route towards robust quantum-state generation by encoding information in symmetry- protected optical modes, yet the generated entangled states are typically dictated by the lattice geometry and therefore lack programmability. Here we demonstrate programmable preparation of topological entangled states by inverse engineering the nonlinear optical pump profile of an integrated photonic lattice. Our approach enables deterministic control over both the dimensionality and modal structure of the generated entangled state while preserving its topological character. We experimentally realize silicon photonic topological superlattices in which the nonlinear generation pathway...

items.title: Trapping of nanofabricated SiO$_2$ high-aspect-ratio discs in an optical lattice
items.abstract: We describe the nanofabrication and loading of lithographically patterned, high aspect ratio $10$ $μ$m diameter silicon dioxide discs with thickness of $400$ nm into an optical standing wave trap in vacuum. We obtain motional spectra of the center of mass motion of the discs using a combination of interferometric and imaging methods. The method is capable of high-efficiency loading and optical trapping using small numbers of objects, of the order of a few particles, with customized geometries and sizes compatible with wafer scale nanofabrication methods. Disc-like particles in optical traps have been identified as promising candidates for detectors of high frequency gravitational waves or as sensitive accelerometers.

items.abstract: Moiré semiconductors provide a physical realization of the Hubbard model. The platform also provides an opportunity to explore the physics of a partially filled Hubbard band at doping densities far away from the Mott insulator, a regime that has remained largely unexplored. Here we report the emergence of an extended strange metal (ESM), in both doping density and twist angle, in a partially filled Hubbard band of twisted bilayer WSe2. items.title: Energetics of Fault-Tolerant Spin-Qubit Quantum Computation
items.abstract: Semiconductor spin qubits offer a promising route to compact and scalable quantum computers, combining long coherence times in isotopically purified silicon with compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing. Beyond computational speedup, their energy efficiency is an important consideration for future large-scale systems. We evaluate the power and energy requirements of a Loss-DiVincenzo spin-qubit quantum computer by analyzing the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) and benchmarking it against the classical Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). We develop a detailed energy budget, identifying cryogenic cooling as the dominant baseline contribution before quantum error correction (QEC). Low magnon damping of a EuSe film down to millikelvin temperatures

items.abstract: A novel silicon allotrope, qtz Si, with quartz topology is proposed and investigated alongside four known allotropes (dia Si-I, lon Si-IV, bsn Si-II, and gsi Si-III) using first-principles density functional theory. qtz Si is found to exhibit the smallest atom-averaged volume (18.06 A3), highest density (2.582 g/cm3), highest bulk modulus (98 GPa), and highest maximum phonon frequency (16 THz) among the five, while showing the lowest shear modulus (37 GPa). items.abstract: Many-body perturbation theory (MBPT) methods, including the GW approximation, the GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation (GW-BSE) method, and GW perturbation theory (GWPT), among others, provide accurate first-principles descriptions of excited-state properties and multiparticle interactions of materials. Large language model (LLM) agents, which couple a language model to software tools, show potential in automating computational tasks, but MBPT remains an unaddressed challenge. items.abstract: In this paper, we develop a novel MIMO controller synthesis method that relies solely on frequency-domain data of discrete-time systems. Such approximations do not provide guarantees on the continuous frequency axis and may fail to capture inter-frequency behavior. We address this limitation by formulating a convex optimization problem that preserves robustness guarantees over the entire frequency range. In particular, the proposed method explicitly accounts for inter-frequency behavior of both plant and controller, leading to certified robust stability and performance. items.title: The Reciprocal tau-Cell: A Log-Domain Circuit for On-Chip Learning
items.abstract: Training hardware by gradient descent requires a gradient to be computed using a separate backwards pass. If a circuit is reciprocal, meaning every connection is symmetric, the backward pass is the same network run a second time with the error as its input. The reciprocal tau-cell, a weak-inversion log-domain circuit, makes this practical in standard CMOS. Each cell is a current-mode leaky integrator with a built-in ReLU; each connection is two transistors whose signed strength is a ratio of bias currents. The equilibrium of the network is the solution to a convex program, and latching the cells that are off will hardware linearise the circuit, making its second run exactly linear. items.title: On-sky performance and prospects of near-infrared CMOS detectors in exoplanet detection: first year of SPIRIT

Their flux peaks in the near-infrared, beyond the wavelength cut-off of the silicon-based CCDs used by ground-based surveys dedicated to observing them, such as SPECULOOS. We present the on-sky performance of SPIRIT (SPeculoos InfraRed Imager for Transits), an InGaAs CMOS detector on the Callisto telescope at the SPECULOOS Southern Observatory, during its first year of operation, from mid-2022 to 2023. We use 328 visits of 73 targets to optimise our CMOS-specific reduction process, including our approach to glow effects and bad-pixel handling. We find the measured precision to be consistent with our theoretical noise model, achieving sub-part-per-thousand precision under good observing conditions across targets spanning $J$-band magnitudes of 10--13. items.abstract: Ferroelectric field-effect transistor (FeFET)-based compute-in-memory (CIM) promises energy-efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference, but device variation can severely degrade bit-sliced CIM accuracy. Prior works either rely on hardware modifications or treat such variation as generic noise, overlooking a key FeFET asymmetry: negligible off-state leakage makes errors dominated by conducting on-state cells. This asymmetry is amplified by two's-complement sign extension, which maps small negative values to high-significance bit slices and magnifies their errors during shift-and-add reconstruction. In this paper, we propose CAFE, a conducting-cell-aware adaptive differential encoding framework built upon this FeFET-specific asymmetry. We observe distinct pressure evolutions of moiré intralayer excitons, which reveal drastic modulation of the excitonic moiré-potential landscape captured by a continuum model and suggest the capability of engineering the exciton-band topology. items.abstract: Anyons are particles with quantized fractional statistics. In theory, a single anyon can be stabilized as a localized fractional charge within the bulk of a topologically ordered two-dimensional insulator. items.title: Direct growth of crystalline spinel GaON films: A wide-bandgap mixed-anion semiconductor
items.abstract: Mixed-anion semiconductors offer opportunities for bandgap engineering beyond conventional multication alloys, but competing phases and disorder complicate their synthesis and the identification of their electronic properties. Gallium oxynitride (GaON) could connect the technologically important GaN and Ga2O3 systems, yet establishing a clear relation between its crystal structure, composition and bandgap remains challenging. items.title: Theoretical study of nitrogen-vacancy spin coherence enhanced by vacancy aggregation in diamond using cluster-correlation expansion
items.abstract: Annealing a semiconductor makes its vacancies mobile; they aggregate into multi-vacancy complexes that often carry spin. Such centres are a magnetic-noise source for any spin qubit among them, in silicon and silicon carbide as well as in diamond, and they are accordingly blamed for NV- decoherence in irradiated and implanted diamond, with two coherence records credited to removing them. Cluster-correlation-expansion simulations driven by published electron-paramagnetic-resonance parameters invert that attribution. At a fixed paramagnetic spin density a multi-vacancy bath gives a Hahn-echo coherence time 3.1-7.1 times longer than a bath of isolated negative vacancies, over three decades of concentration. A bath dephases the qubit because its spins exchange spin projections with one another, and two can exchange only if their transition frequencies match. A fine-structure splitting shifts...

items.title: Device contacts as spin-state selectors for silicon vacancies in 4H-SiC
items.abstract: Optically addressable defect spins in semiconductors are promising building blocks for scalable quantum technologies. Yet, the consequences of conventional contact schemes used in semiconductor device integration for the quantum spin environment remain largely unexplored. Using the silicon vacancy (V$_\mathrm{Si}$) in silicon carbide (SiC) as a model system, we show that a widely used contact metal, nickel (Ni), intrinsically perturbs the defect spin state and quenches the characteristic emission from the spin-quartet channel of V$_\mathrm{Si}$. Low-energy muon spin rotation further reveals that Ni contacts create a magnetically contaminated region extending at least $\sim$110 nm into the SiC, in stark contrast to non-magnetic contacts such as Ti and Al. Moreover, cross-sectional cathodoluminescence measurements on samples with high defect density demonstrate a suppressed quartet-state l...

items.title: A semiconductor photon-pair source based on a polariton cascade
items.abstract: We present a theoretical study of a semiconductor photon-pair source based on a radiative cascade enabled by a permanent exciton dipole. The source consists of a GaAs quantum dot placed between a metal nanoparticle and a mirror. The dot exciton and the localized electromagnetic mode mix to form upper and lower polaritons. Without a permanent dipole, a symmetry separating states with even and odd excitation numbers forbids photon emission between the polaritons. Separation of the mean electron and hole positions gives the exciton a permanent dipole and breaks this symmetry. The upper polariton can then emit an idler photon as it decays to the lower polariton. The lower polariton can emit a signal photon as the system returns to its ground state. Using an effective model, we calculate the probability that a prepared upper polariton emits both photons through the metal antenna. We also anal...

items.title: Accelerating Periodic Coupled Cluster and Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction Theories With Frozen Natural Orbitals
items.abstract: We present a unified frozen natural orbital (FNO) framework for periodic Gaussian-orbital post-Hartree-Fock calculations with explicit k-point sampling. The approach includes conventional ground-state FNOs together with state-specific (SS-FNO) and state-averaged (SA-FNO) variants constructed from perturbative one-particle density matrices. We implement these approximations for periodic Moller-Plesset perturbation theory, algebraic diagrammatic construction, and equation-of-motion coupled cluster methods in the PySCF software package and benchmark them for correlation energies, equations of state, fundamental band gaps, and quasiparticle band structures of semiconductors and insulators. FNO truncation reproduces canonical results with small errors while substantially reducing computational cost. SS-FNO enables accurate large-basis band-gap calculations, including quadruple-zeta results, w...

items.title: An Emerging NVM-Based On-Chip Training Architecture with Non-Ideality Mitigation Through Bipolar Weight Distributions
items.abstract: The rapid advancement of deep learning has presented significant energy efficiency challenges to the conventional von Neumann architecture. In-memory computing (IMC) architectures based on emerging non-volatile memory (eNVM) are widely regarded as a promising solution for accelerating neural network training due to their high parallelism and low power consumption. However, the intrinsic non-idealities of eNVM devices can cause conductance updates to deviate from target values, thereby limiting the performance of on-chip training. To address this challenge, this paper presents a Non-ideality Optimized eNVM Accelerator (NOVA) architecture for on-chip training. Specifically, we first fabricate a two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectric field-effect transistor (FeFET) and develop a conductance modulation behavioral model calibrated with experimental data. Building upon this device model, we propos...

items.title: JANUS: A Multi-modal Foundation Neural Sampler for Disordered Materials
items.abstract: Disordered materials are central to modern technologies, from high-performance alloys to quantum devices, yet understanding and designing them requires exploring an enormous space of compositions and atomic arrangements. Here we introduce JANUS, a multimodal neural sampler that jointly explores chemical composition, atomic structure and volume, learning directly from the energy of the system without requiring pre-generated equilibrium configurations. Across test systems, JANUS reproduces reference equilibrium properties and recovers free energy and phase behavior with about three orders of magnitude fewer energy evaluations than reference Monte Carlo sampling. In multicomponent alloys, JANUS reproduces experimentally observed local chemical order and can be steered to further enhance chemical order and stiffness. Coupled to an evolutionary language model agent, it also enables efficient...

items.title: On-chip nanoplasma for adaptive electromagnetic protection
items.abstract: Over the past decade, semiconductor diodes have served as the primary switching elements in adaptive electromagnetic (EM) protection, yet their performance has been compromised by parasitic effects and thermal accumulation, rendering them inadequate against the rapidly evolving landscape of high-power microwave (HPM) threats. Here we show that on-chip nanoplasma switches (NPMS), composed of gallium nitride electrodes on silicon carbide substrates, exhibit superior radio frequency (RF) and thermal characteristics, positioning them as ideal field-driven switches in RF front-end protectors. By integrating NPMS into metasurfaces, antennas and circuit limiters, we achieve an adaptive response that ensures low-loss transmission for normal signals and high shielding against HPMs, while offering extended operating bandwidth and substantially higher tolerance than conventional solid-state devices...

items.title: Odd-even dichotomy in the waveforms of modified Emden oscillators of arbitrary integer power
items.abstract: Closed-form waveforms of the modified Emden oscillators $\ddot x+(q+2)kx^q\dot x+k^2x^{2q+1}+ω^2x=0$ of arbitrary natural power $q$, and of their damped $c$-deformed versions, are obtained through a generalized commutative factorization that reduces them to Bernoulli equations. We show that commutative factorizations of Liénard equations are gauge-conjugated forms of the nonlocal linearizing transformation of Chandrasekar, Senthilvelan, Kundu and Lakshmanan, the factorization constant being half the difference of the roots of the associated linear oscillator. These oscillators display an odd--even dichotomy: for odd $q$ they are isochronous, with period $2π/ω$ independent of the amplitude, within an explicitly bounded range of the integration constant, while for even $q$ the oscillations decay algebraically, as $t^{-1/q}$. The dichotomy is confirmed by an elliptic polar representation, i...

items.title: Strain engineering of transient exciton diffusion in WSe2 monolayers at cryogenic temperatures
items.abstract: Tungsten-based transition metal dichalcogenides exhibit dark excitons as the energetically lowest states. These are crucial for exciton thermalization and propagation and they dominate low-temperature photoluminescence via the emergence of pronounced phonon sidebands. After a resonant excitation, highly mobile hot dark excitons are formed, which quickly thermalize into an equilibrium distribution. The application of strain modifies the exciton energy landscape and, in particular, the relative energy separation between bright and dark exciton states. The impact of strain on the transient photoluminescence and diffusion of non-equilibrium excitons has remained largely unexplored so far. In this work, we investigate the spatiotemporal exciton dynamics in strained hBN-encapsulated WSe2 monolayers at cryogenic temperatures. We demonstrate that tensile strain abruptly increases the excess ener...

items.title: Approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser for reducing energy consumption
items.abstract: Photonic reservoir computing is a promising physical machine-learning approach for time-series prediction. Quantization of the reservoir response signal is an important consideration in the implementation of photonic reservoir computing, and the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency need to be optimized to achieve high prediction performance and low energy consumption. However, few studies have investigated the effects of the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency on both prediction performance and energy consumption. In this study, we introduce the concept of approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser by quantizing the reservoir node states and output weights. We numerically evaluate the performance of a chaotic time-series prediction task and estimate the energy consumption per sample using a component-level model. By optimizing the number of qu...

items.title: Photon-conserving Raman soliton attractors in focusing and defocusing Kerr media
items.abstract: The sign of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient has long been regarded as irrelevant to the direction of the Raman-induced soliton self-frequency shift. Yet the standard generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) predicts a frequency shift that depends on the sign of the nonlinearity, which leads to an unphysical blue shift in the defocusing case. We resolve this inconsistency by deriving the time-domain form of the photon-conserving GNLSE (pcGNLSE) from its established frequency-domain counterpart. The derivation reveals that photon-number conservation imposes two sign modifications relative to the standard GNLSE: the Raman-shift coefficient acquires the absolute value of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient in place of its signed counterpart, and the self-steepening-Raman dissipation term likewise carries an absolute-value prefactor rather than a signed one. These two modifications jointl...

items.title: Graph-Based Kirchhoff Modeling of Non-Ohmic Electron Transport in Self-Assembled Nanonecklace Networks
items.abstract: Gold nanonecklace networks exhibit non-Ohmic current--voltage I-V characteristics with a sharp conduction threshold, making them promising for sensing and transistor-like devices. However, their conduction has been understood largely empirically, because experiments cannot see how conduction evolves inside the network. To address this, we develop a graph-based Kirchhoff modeling framework that resolves these internal processes, tracking the potential and current of every junction. Although every active element conducts linearly, the model reproduces the non-Ohmic response $I \propto (V-V_T)^ζ$. It also captures the experimentally observed effects of junction properties, network density, and voids, which lends confidence to its predicted internal states. These states show that the non-Ohmic response emerges from voltage-driven percolation. Conduction is governed by how junctions are conne...

items.title: Electron state tomography from quasiparticle interference maps
items.abstract: Characterizing electronic band structures requires precise knowledge of wave functions and their quantum geometry. Here, we introduce a tomography method to reconstruct the density matrix of electron states from quasiparticle interference maps around single impurities. We consider two-orbital models on a honeycomb lattice, relevant to graphene heterostructures and direct-gap semiconductors. For on-site impurities, backscattering between time-reversed states directly maps the density matrix populations and coherences into distinct orbital contributions in the interference map. While local probes usually lack orbital resolution, these orbital contributions transform under distinct symmetry group representations and can thus be disentangled to reveal the density matrix and quantum geometric tensor of the scattering states. This establishes impurities as tomographic probes for band structure...

items.title: Absorption and Phase-Contrast Microtomography Using Direct X-Ray Detection With Commercial Off-The-Shelf CMOS Sensors
items.abstract: This work presents high-resolution X-ray microtomography based on commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) CMOS image sensors as direct detectors. The system uses a microfocus X-ray source in cone-beam geometry, enabling both absorption-contrast imaging, thanks to the sensor s intrinsic resolution, and phase-contrast imaging, by adjusting the object-to-sensor distance. A dynamic flat-field correction algorithm mitigates radiation-induced sensor degradation during long acquisitions. The setup provides voxel sizes from 3.9 microns to 5.2 microns, with an effective spatial resolution (FWHM) as fine as 9.6 microns in magnified phase-contrast mode (1.33x) and 21 microns in non-magnified absorption-contrast mode. Phase contrast enhances visualization of soft tissue boundaries that are difficult to visualize using absorption-contrast imaging in the same experimental configuration.

items.title: Exciton-Tunable Phase Control and Superstrong Coupling Through Multimode Polariton Engineering in Planar Waveguides
items.abstract: Strong light-matter coupling in optical waveguides provides a versatile platform for engineering hybrid polaritonic modes and their dispersion. Here we investigate multimode exciton-photon coupling in visible semiconductor waveguides supporting several transverse electric modes. Using rigorous coupled-wave analysis combined with a coupled-oscillator model, we show that the photonic band structure can be engineered across a range of regimes, from conventional multimode strong coupling to the superstrong coupling regime, where the Rabi splitting becomes comparable to the spacing between adjacent photonic modes. In the latter regime, hybridization between orthogonal electromagnetic modes is enabled by restricting the active material to a subregion of the mode volume where the photonic modes exhibit strong mutual overlap. This breaking of the orthogonality leads to polaritonic branches whose...

items.title: Energy Consumption in Next Generation Radio Access Networks
items.abstract: Historically, in macro-cell-based networks, the radio access network (RAN) portion accounts for the largest share of energy consumption in mobile networks. With greater densification, the transition to small cells and increased virtualization of the radio processing functions, the relative energy use of the different network segments is changing. At the same time, open radio access networks (O-RAN) have emerged as a promising approach to support this evolution through open interfaces that enable a multi-vendor environment, support for hierarchical intelligent controls, and simplified, cost-effective radio units that facilitate large-scale deployments. This paper examines the impact of these changes on energy consumption in next-generation RAN architectures through transaction-based energy models.
